name: Acceptance suite-3 test 83 - one invalid member poisons a Principal AWS array
note: IAM-1004 (Phase 10) Campaign D: a Principal AWS array mixing a valid role ARN (index 0) with a partial-wildcard ARN (index 1, role/invalid-*) must identify the invalid member by its ARRAY INDEX (Principal.AWS[1]) and must NOT silently drop it and report a complete result for only ValidRole. The invalid member fails closed (TRUST-INVALID-PRINCIPAL + INVALID_PRINCIPAL_WILDCARD_ARN, coverage incomplete); the valid ValidRole is still analyzed (TRUST-CROSS-ACCOUNT) but the overall result is explicitly incomplete, never presented as clean.
